rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve frozen opening launch and fixed early pixel bend steering only; no added gas or braking.
expected_success_endpoint: Unchanged exact launch-plus-steering ZIP completes at least as many of 12 reserved confirmation cells as unchanged launch-only control; if tied, median finished lap is shorter.
falsifier: Lower candidate completion, candidate-only nonfinish, invalid action/resource breach, or no median lap improvement when completion ties.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Run the same exact two ZIP hashes on reserved confirmation tracks 1-3 by seeds 7032-7035, 12 paired cells and 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local Linux CPU 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; this is local confirmation, not official private score or upload.
